entries.name: tx-ext-func-2-2-reject#0
entries.description: Input 0's extension is {0: the constant empty Coll[Int => Int]} (0c 70 01 04 04 00 00). Under (2, 2), a peer's transaction while block version 3 was current: TypeSerializer reads the function type code 0x70 only when the context's tree version is at least 3 (TypeSerializer.scala:215 at v6.0.7). Otherwise the code falls to the unknown-type branch, whose rule the activated version picks (:228-236): 1018 from activated 3, 1008 below. Rule 1008: the JVM rejects.
